stories.title: Peltola campaign loses in court on rejected absentee ballots as she maintains narrow lead
stories.summary: Democratic Senate nominee Mary Peltola lost her court bid for ballot records and saw her narrow Alaska lead over Dan Sullivan shrink Wednesday.

stories.title: Peltola holds lead, but Sullivan gains after latest Alaska Senate vote drop
stories.summary: Former Rep. Mary Peltola’s (D-Alaska) campaign said Wednesday that Sen. Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) is running out of opportunities to overcome her lead in the state’s closely contested Senate race.
stories.why: Officeholders can build support that outlasts party tides.
